description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in fostering a positive and efficient work environment for our nursing team.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, training, and performance evaluation, contributing to the continuous improvement of our clinical services. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence in patient care. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to bring a strong clinical foundation to this leadership opportunity.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Previous supervisory or leadership experience in a healthcare environment
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory requirements
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Milbank, SD. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance within a supportive environment. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture of excellence and compassion.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, manage staff, and implement best practices to deliver exceptional care to our residents. Your leadership will directly impact the well-being of patients and the professional growth of our nursing team. This is a chance to make a significant difference in a community-focused setting.

Join a facility committed to providing comprehensive care and rehabilitation services. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about nursing and dedicated to achieving outstanding outcomes.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in South Dakota
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role (e.g., DON, ADON)
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
